requirements.general_text: Passed Malaysian Higher School Certificate (Sijil Tinggi Pelajaran Malaysia – STPM) with a minimum C Grade (NGMP 2.00) in any two (2) subjects, and passed in Mathematics and English at Malaysian Certificate of Education (SPM) level; OR Passed Malaysian Higher Religious Ceritificate (STAM) with a minimum Jayyid grade, and passed in Mathematics and English at Malaysian Certificate of Education (SPM) level; OR Passed Foundation/Matriculation/Diploma or equivalent with minimum CGPA 2.00; OR Passed Malaysian Skills Diploma (DKM)/Malaysian Skills Advanced Diploma (DLKM) / Malaysian Vocational Diploma (DVM) in a related field with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 and got full accreditation. Passed United Examination Certificate (UEC) with minimum B Grade in any five (5) subjects, including Mathematics and English.
